id: ISS-0950
title: "Catalog service endpoint_url is not URL-validated at registration/publish time (decision 0027 gap)"
discovered_by: SECURITY-REVIEWER

severity: MINOR

description: >
  Found by SECURITY-REVIEWER in WF03-ISS0917-20261001. POST /service-catalog and publish do no
  UrlValidator check on endpoint_url; the only control is the dispatch-time INV-9 gate in
  ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport/3. ISS-0917's fix makes catalog endpoints reachable by the
  dispatcher for the first time, so add fast-feedback syntactic validation (https scheme, host not
  private/loopback literal) at register/publish time in Letflow.ServiceCatalog /
  Routers.AdminServices. Defense in depth; dispatch gate stays binding. Severity MINOR (hardening).
  Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via CODE-DESIGNER).

  - lib/letflow/routers/admin_services.ex

task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 FIX DESIGN. Read the step-01 diagnosis (result.summary in handoffs/WF03-ISS0950-20261001/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json) and produce a design artefact at lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md (design doc only, no implementation code). Stay in the main checkout on branch feature/WF03-ISS0950-20261001. Scope: fast-feedback SYNTACTIC validation of endpoint_url at register/1 and publish/3 (Entry changesets are the natural single choke point; 422 mapping already exists), reusing Letflow.Webhooks.UrlValidator logic WITHOUT DNS resolution (decide: new public no-DNS function on UrlValidator vs stub resolver; justify; DNS must not happen at register time). Rules to decide explicitly: https only; host present; reject private/loopback/link-local/metadata IP literals (reuse the dispatcher blocklist, do not duplicate it); template handling -- endpoint_url is a template rendered with {{variables.KEY}} at activation, so specify exactly how templates are validated (e.g. validate scheme prefix and, if host part contains no template token, host literal; what to do when the host itself is templated; the fixture at test/letflow/engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs:363 registers a bare {{variables.absent}} -- state whether that fixture must change and why that is acceptable or how to avoid breaking it); error shape (changeset error key/message so 422 body is stable); both insert and publish changesets; update/new-version paths if any. Dispatch gate (INV-9) stays binding and unchanged -- state it. Honour decision 0027 and security-invariants.md INV-9. Include: function signatures with @spec, exact list of files to change, exact list of existing tests/fixtures to adjust, and a test matrix (accepted and rejected URLs, templated cases, both write paths, router-level 422 assertion, plus a unit test asserting no DNS lookup happens). Severity MINOR; keep the change small. Complete the handoff per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md; do not commit (ORCH commits).

REWORK ITERATION 1 (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR FAIL, see handoffs/WF03-ISS0950-20261001/step-02b-code-design-validator.json): BLOCKER: R-MISSING and D5's parenthetical are wrong for publish/3 with the endpoint_url key ABSENT: publish base struct is the current row (service_catalog.ex:405-406), so validate_required passes and get_field validates the STORED value (good stored -> publish succeeds keeping old URL; bad stored -> endpoint_url_not_allowed). Only explicit nil / empty / whitespace gives the validate_required error. Restate R-MISSING per write path, add the absent-key publish as its own matrix row with the intended outcome, correct D5, and state whether making endpoint_url mandatory on publish is in or out of scope (recommend out). MINORs: fixture precedent is raw SQL via Repo.query not Repo.update_all; U-NODNS(b) trace patterns must not use 1..2 as arity (list each arity or use :_); make section 4's optional/conditional docs items binary do/do-not. Edit the existing design file in place. On finishing, flip status to COMPLETED/FAILED as normal (do not leave IN_PROGRESS).
acceptance_criteria: Design file exists at lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md with no implementation code beyond signatures/specs
Template-URL policy fully specified incl. the {{variables.absent}} fixture
Files-to-change and tests-to-adjust lists are exact
Test matrix covers every rejected/accepted class and both write paths

result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/iss0950-catalog-endpoint-url-register-validation.md (signatures/specs and prose only). Decisions: (D1) check lives in Entry.insert_changeset/2 and Entry.publish_changeset/2, the only two endpoint_url input paths; no router change (existing Changeset clause gives 422 'validation failed'). (D2) no-DNS via a new public UrlValidator.validate_syntactic/1 sharing the private scheme/host/IP-literal checks (not a stub resolver: structural no-DNS, no blocklist copy). (D3) template policy: head = text up to first / ? # after '://'; placeholders allowed only in the tail; any { or } in head (scheme/userinfo/host/port) is rejected; only head is passed to the validator so the engine regex is not duplicated. (D4) one changeset error on :endpoint_url, validation: :endpoint_url_not_allowed, fixed message. (D5) validation uses get_field, not validate_change, so republishing an unchanged legacy-bad URL is still checked (cast records no change). (D6/D7) stored bad rows tolerated; rejected publish rolls back the archive insert. Dispatch gate (INV-9, ServiceTaskDispatcher.http_transport) stated unchanged. Exactly one existing test changes: engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs ~line 363 ({{variables.absent}}) is re-seeded via register with the valid URL then a raw update_all, assertions unchanged, because register now rejects it; all other fixtures verified to use literal https://example.test heads. Test matrix covers 22 reject and 10 accept classes at pure/register/publish/HTTP levels plus P-SAME-URL, P-ROLLBACK, length dedupe, and a two-part no-DNS unit test (contrast + trace). Not run: no code or tests (design only). One unverified assumption: the fixture reseed relies on the engine resolving the pinned version from the live row by version_id; ELIXIR-DEV must confirm when running that test file.
